Name: PERMANENT_BUFF_PARAM_ST
Description: How permanent buffs appear in the status list: name and text from the SpEffect, the value display format and the icon.

Fields.Name: SpEffect ID
Fields.Description: SpEffect the buff grants. Its first SpEffect text (Slot 1: SpEffect Text ID) gives the buff's name, caption and info text in menus.

Fields.Name: Icon ID
Fields.Description: Icon shown for the buff in menus.

Fields.Name: Secondary Icon ID
Fields.Description: No reader found. Retail: 40229 on the Key Item rows, -1 elsewhere.

Fields.Name: Display Numeric Value
Fields.Description: Set: the buff's text shows Numeric Value after its name. Retail: set on 42 of 123 rows (the "(+N%)" buffs).

Fields.Name: Show SpEffect Icons
Fields.Description: Set: the icons of the buff's SpEffect are collected for display. Retail: set on every row.

Fields.Name: Ignore Numeric Value
Fields.Description: Non-zero: the shown value is 0 instead of Numeric Value. Retail 0.

Fields.Name: Value Display Format
Fields.Description: How Numeric Value is written: 0 = signed number, 1 = signed with the first unit text (%), 2 = unsigned with that text, 3 = signed with the second unit text, 4 = unsigned with it, 5 = plain unsigned number. Retail: 1 on the "(+N%)" rows, 0 elsewhere.

Fields.Name: Grace SpEffect Count Type
Fields.Description: How the buff counts Grace: SpEffect ID: 0 = number of active instances of that SpEffect; other values use a second counting mode (not traced). Retail 0.

Fields.Name: Numeric Value
Fields.Description: Number shown after the buff's name when Display Numeric Value is set, formatted by Value Display Format.

Fields.Name: Counted SpEffect ID
Fields.Description: SpEffect whose active instances are counted for this buff (see Grace SpEffect Count Type). -1: none. Retail: only row 8970000 (Traces of Grace-Given Lord, counting 8970000).
